before.text:
Abstract. In this work we use a commutative generalization of complex numbers, called bicomplex numbers,
to introduce a holomorphic Riemann zeta function of two complex variables satisfying the complexified Cauchy-
Riemann equations. Furthermore, we establish a bicomplex Riemann hypothesis equivalent to the complex Riemann
hypothesis of one variable and we obtain a bicomplex Euler Product.

section_entries.label: 4. Zeros of zeta(w)
section_entries.mathematical_role: Reduces bicomplex zeros to simultaneous zeros of both complex idempotent components and identifies the trivial-zero lattice.

unit_result_entry.title: Bicomplex zeros require simultaneous component zeros
unit_result_entry.why_material: Orthogonal idempotent components force zeta(w)=0 precisely when both scalar zeta values vanish. Applying the classical trivial-zero set then produces a two-parameter lattice of trivial bicomplex zeros.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: The complex pole lifts to an entire translated zero-divisor polar set
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Approaching any point where either idempotent coordinate equals the classical pole forces the bicomplex norm to diverge. Thus the excluded set is not an arbitrary technical domain restriction but the maximal obstruction inherited componentwise.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: A bicomplex zero-coordinate condition equivalent to classical RH
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The proposed bicomplex condition encodes the possibilities in which both idempotent coordinates are zeta zeros, allowing trivial/nontrivial mixtures as well as two nontrivial components. Classical RH implies the listed coordinate loci; conversely a hypothetical off-critical classical zero embeds diagonally as a bicomplex zero that violates them.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Once bicomplex objects split into two orthogonal complex components, convergence, holomorphic continuation, zeros, and Euler factorization are transported by applying the classical construction separately and recombining.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: This is a within-source structural synthesis, not evidence that every complex-analytic property transfers; zero divisors and domain topology create explicit failures.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Idempotent decomposition as a transport functor for zeta structure

related_synthesis_entries.claim: A classical off-critical zero can be embedded with equal idempotent coordinates, turning any violation of classical RH into a violation of the proposed bicomplex coordinate condition.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The exact forward coordinate loci in the bicomplex conjecture require scan verification; only the converse mechanism is transcription-stable.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Classical RH is recovered by a diagonal bicomplex embedding

related_synthesis_entries.claim: When idempotent arguments are restricted from complex to real values, simultaneous zeta zeros can only use real trivial zeros, so the nontrivial-zero question disappears rather than yielding a new RH analogue.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: This conclusion concerns the source's chosen hyperbolic restriction and definition, not every possible hyperbolic zeta construction.
